name: NewHire
description: Central data model capturing new employee information and onboarding status throughout the hiring and onboarding lifecycle

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the new hire record

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: Complete legal name of the new employee

fields.name: email
fields.description: Primary email address for communication and system access

fields.name: positionTitle
fields.description: Job title or position the new hire will fill

fields.name: startDate
fields.description: Official first day of employment

fields.name: onboardingStatus
fields.description: Current stage in the onboarding process (e.g., pending, in_progress, completed)

fields.name: departmentId
fields.description: Reference to the department the new hire will join

fields.name: managerId
fields.description: Reference to the direct manager or supervisor

name: OnboardingTask
description: Tracks individual tasks and milestones in the onboarding workflow with status tracking, assignments, and completion records

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the onboarding task

fields.name: newHireId
fields.description: Reference to the new hire this task belongs to

fields.name: title
fields.description: Name of the task (e.g., 'Complete I-9 Form', 'Manager Sign-off', 'Background Check')

fields.name: assignedTo
fields.description: User ID of the person responsible for completing the task (HR staff, manager, or new hire)

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the task (pending, in_progress, completed, approved, rejected)

fields.name: dueDate
fields.description: Deadline for task completion

fields.name: completedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the task was completed

fields.name: completedBy
fields.description: User ID of the person who completed or approved the task

relationships.description: Each task belongs to one new hire

name: Document
description: Stores uploaded documents and tracks document submission requirements for new hires

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the document

fields.name: newHireId
fields.description: Reference to the new hire who submitted the document

fields.name: documentType
fields.description: Type of document (e.g., ID, tax_form, certification, contract)

fields.name: fileName
fields.description: Original name of the uploaded file

fields.name: fileUrl
fields.description: Storage location or URL reference to the uploaded file

fields.name: status
fields.description: Submission status (e.g., pending, approved, rejected)

fields.name: uploadedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the document was uploaded

fields.name: reviewedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the document was reviewed/approved

relationships.description: Each document belongs to one new hire

name: EquipmentRequest
description: Manages IT and office equipment requests for new hires including approval, fulfillment, and delivery tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the equipment request

fields.name: newHireId
fields.description: Reference to the new hire receiving the equipment

fields.name: equipmentItems
fields.description: List of requested equipment items (laptops, monitors, phones, software licenses, office supplies)

fields.name: approvalStatus
fields.description: Current approval status (pending, approved, rejected)

fields.name: fulfillmentStatus
fields.description: Current fulfillment status (not_started, in_progress, completed, delivered)

fields.name: requestedDate
fields.description: Date when the equipment request was created

fields.name: targetDeliveryDate
fields.description: Expected delivery date to ensure first-day readiness

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Additional notes or special instructions for the equipment request

relationships.description: Each equipment request belongs to one new hire

name: TrainingAssignment
description: Manages training module assignments and completion tracking for new hires

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the training assignment

fields.name: newHireId
fields.description: Reference to the new hire assigned to this training

fields.name: trainingModuleName
fields.description: Name of the training module or course

fields.name: enrollmentDate
fields.description: Date when the training was assigned to the new hire

fields.name: dueDate
fields.description: Deadline for completing the training module

fields.name: completionDate
fields.description: Date when the training was completed

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the training assignment (Not Started, In Progress, Completed, Overdue)

fields.name: certificationUrl
fields.description: URL or reference to the certification document upon completion

relationships.description: Each training assignment belongs to one new hire

constraints.completionDateValidation: completionDate must be after enrollmentDate when set
